cue: The protocol note explicitly states the pilot scores use a 0-50 scale and warns they must not be combined with 0-100 data.

matchers.why: Names the 0-50 pilot scoring scale that differentiates these values from the 0-100 standard.
Direct instruction not to pool these pilot values with the 0-100 standard.
Signals that the numeric scores are on a different scale and have not been adjusted.
